alerts.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued November 20 at 4:01AM PST until November 20 at 10:00AM PST by NWS Reno NV
alerts.description:
* WHAT...Snow. Snow accumulations up to 1 inch. Locally up to 3
inches under snow bands.

* WHERE...Greater Reno-Carson City-Minden Area.

* WHEN...Until 10 AM PST this morning.

* IMPACTS...Plan on slippery road conditions. The hazardous
conditions will impact the Friday morning commute.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Snow is accumulating in several areas this
morning, including west Reno, north Reno, Washoe Valley, and Carson
City. Bands of snow, including a lake enhanced snow band off Lake
Tahoe, will continue to bring periods of accumulating snow through
the morning commute. Where these bands set up is uncertain, so snow
amounts will vary greatly over short distances.
alerts.instruction:
Slow down and use caution while traveling. The latest road conditions
for the state you are calling from can be obtained by calling 5 1 1.
Check with NDOT for the latest road conditions.
